chapter: After the Army: JATP, clubs and first Europe trips
title: Substituting for Armstrong on a Paris record date
summary: When Armstrong couldn't record, Clayton was called with Earl Hines, Barney Bigard and Arvell Shaw for a 1949 session.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well when was it that you went with Barney Bigard and Earl Hines?
Yes, I didn't go with them. I was in Paris.

Yes. And Louis couldn't record. They had a record date but they wouldn't let him record. He was under contract already to another company. So they had already hired Earl Hines, Arvell Shaw and Barney Bigard. Teagarden didn't make it either. So they called me on trumpet and we made the date.
Well that was a pretty successful date apart from the recording quality wasn't very good. Things like, 'Night life in Pompei', they were very good.
I enjoyed it. I enjoyed it.
Well you made a lot of records.....
